description: First golden fixture: the example in the FSANZ guidance (February 2026, p. 2): 'Servings per package: 12', 'Serving size: 60 mL (1 standard drink)', 355 kJ per serving and 592 kJ per 100 mL, with averages indicated in the column headings. The guidance does not state the example's ABV: 21.1% is used because it gives 1.0 standard drink per 60 mL serving. Package volume is 12 x 60 mL = 720 mL.
